longDescription: Reads the LangHuan central providers.json (~/.agents/skills/langhuan-lit-scout-harvester/config/providers.json) and syncs enabled, non-reserved OpenAI-compatible providers into Kimi Code's config.toml. Each provider becomes a [providers."langhuan-<id>"] table (type/base_url/api_key_env), and each model becomes a [models."langhuan-<id>--<model>"] table. Secrets are referenced only by api_key_env variable names, which Kimi resolves from its process environment; scripts and configuration files never contain plaintext keys. Content outside the managed marker block is preserved, and repeated runs are idempotent.

provider-config.description: Field mapping, synchronization workflow, and API-key environment variable setup for providers.json and Kimi Code config.toml
